en.title: DOJ Extends Accessibility Deadline, Hearing Tech Installed, Seattle Agent Honored
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice has extended the deadline for compliance with accessibility regulations, outlining what changes and what remains unchanged. In Ontario, a new hearing accessibility technology was installed at a veterans unit with a $192,100 grant. Meanwhile, a Seattle real estate agent received a fair housing honor for a decade‑long effort to improve accessibility in housing.

highlights.title: The DOJ Extended the Accessibility Deadline. What That Means and What Hasn’t Changed.
Hearing Accessibility Technology Installed at ANAF Unit 261
Decade-long accessibility push earns Seattle agent fair housing honor

zh-TW.title: 司法部延長無障礙期限，西雅圖榮譽及日本推文譴責嘲諷
zh-TW.summary: 司法部已延長無障礙合規期限，說明哪些內容變動與哪些保持不變。西雅圖房地產經紀人因十年推動無障礙住房獲得公平住房榮譽。此外，一則日本推文譴責對殘障人士與女性的嘲諷，呼籲停止此類行為。

highlights.title: 司法部延長無障礙期限。這意味著什麼以及什麼沒有改變。
西雅圖經紀人因十年無障礙推動獲得公平住房榮譽
